payroll.title: Payroll software
payroll.whatItMeans: Your payroll software sends each pay run to EPFO as it happens; the month's runs add up into your ECR, which you still approve and pay.
payroll.explanationBody: Connect your payroll system to EPFO. When you authorise a provider, your payroll software can submit pay runs directly as pay dates occur. Individual pay runs are validated and accumulated into your monthly Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR). You retain full authority to review, approve, and pay the final ECR.
payroll.noAvailable: No payroll software providers are currently listed.
payroll.noAuthorised: No payroll providers have been authorised yet.
payroll.authoriseStepUpSummary: Authorise {{name}} to submit payroll runs directly on behalf of your establishment.
payroll.revokeReasonPlaceholder: State why this provider's authorisation is being revoked (at least 5 characters)
payroll.revokeReasonRequired: Enter a revocation reason between 5 and 300 characters.
payroll.revokeStepUpSummary: Revoke authorisation for {{name}}. The software will no longer be able to submit pay runs.
payroll.ownerOnlyNotice: Only the establishment owner can authorise or revoke payroll software providers. Other users have read-only access.
payroll.readOnlyNotice: Read-only view: Only the employer owner can authorise or revoke payroll providers.
payroll.payRunsDescription: Pay runs sent by your authorised payroll software for the wage month. Accepted runs combine into your monthly ECR draft.
payroll.noPayRuns: No pay runs submitted for this wage month yet.
payroll.noMembers: No member wage records found for this wage month.
payroll.makeEcr: Make the ECR from these pay runs
payroll.cannotMakeEcr: Cannot make ECR draft at this time.
payroll.ecrDraftCreated: ECR draft created from pay runs
payroll.goToEcr: Go to ECR to approve and pay
payroll.permissionRequired: The 'ecr.prepare' permission is required to create an ECR draft.
